items.title: How a Democrat in Michigan rocked the party days before the US midterms
items.description: BBC's Nada Tawfik visited Detroit, Michigan where the party spat unfolded.

items.title: Trump makes final campaign push in final weekend before election
items.description: The US president rallied in states that Republicans previously won - showcasing how tight Tuesday's elections could be in determining control of Congress.

items.title: Nine killed as small jet crashes on Florida street
items.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy described the crash, which happened near President Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort, as a "horrific tragedy".

items.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
items.description: The exchange froze transactions following the incident which has been linked to a North Korean group.

items.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
items.description: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.

items.title: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after 20 years
items.description: The country was the first to contribute troops to the AU mission established to stabilise Somalia in 2007.

items.title: China state broadcaster pulls La Liga matches following Mbappé joke
items.description: China Media Group, which acknowledged Mbappé's apology, has not said how long the blackout will last.

items.title: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
items.description: There were hundreds of arrests as protesters took to the streets in cities across France for the third weekend in a row.

items.title: Popular Australian children's author jailed over child exploitation offences
items.description: The author of Jasper Jones and Runt pleaded guilty in May after police raided his home months earlier.

items.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
items.description: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.

items.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
items.description: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.

items.title: University of Cambridge scientist among those who died in Spanish train crash
items.description: Marta Shahbazi was an "inspiring, talented and passionate scientist", says the laboratory where she worked.

items.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
items.description: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.

items.title: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
items.description: Thousands gathered in the heart of delhi, calling for the chief election commissioner to step down.

items.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
items.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.

items.title: Judge dismisses Trump's lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday book
items.description: Trump had sued the media outlet after it published a letter to Epstein purportedly written and signed by the president as part of a birthday book.

items.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
items.description: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.

items.title: Alaska Senate candidate denies knowing about alleged plot to put two Dan Sullivans on ballot
items.description: The incumbent Republican running for re-election and allies have accused the Democrats of trying to confuse voters by recruiting a second Dan Sullivan to also stand in the race.

items.title: More than 5,000 die from Ebola in DR Congo's deadliest outbreak
items.description: Government data shows that more than 10,000 people have contracted the rare virus.

items.title: North Carolina voters weigh up Trump's track record on cost of living
items.description: The BBC's Clive Myrie found voters in the state were asking themselves whether they were better off than two years ago.
